blocked: Procedural relief studies are not finished painted HoMM3 art. The required built-in image_gen.imagegen tool is unavailable in this session; no alternate API or image generation was used.
source: render.py contains original editable paths, relief shading and material recipes; this file contains the mechanic mapping and fixed presentation contract.

generation.method: original authored geometry and deterministic Pillow/numpy raster shading

presentation.camera: fixed orthographic frontal material relief for every icon and size
presentation.fit: whole canvas; LANCZOS reduction; never per-hero auto-fit
presentation.palette: aged bronze, ivory linen, dark teal lacquer, blue mana, restrained rose and violet
presentation.alpha: transparent external margin; same inset dark material plaque for all contexts; clear reduction-only alpha <=4/255 and clear RGB under alpha zero to remove LANCZOS ringing

heroes.motif: A blue droplet falls into a bronze bowl, with a small rising sun and fixed +1 seal.
heroes.reading: Daily spell-point recovery, not maximum-mana capacity or a Mysticism skill specialty.
heroes.limitation: Bowl and droplet are legible; daily timing still needs tooltip. Could be misread as healing without the blue mana convention.

heroes.motif: Generic red-sashed resistance troop torso with an ordinary held blade; bronze/steel paired rank fittings.
heroes.reading: Resistance Blade and Resistance Veteran creature specialty, not Irelia's floating weapons.
heroes.limitation: Abstract troop equipment token is not a faithful finished troop miniature; no numeric tier formula is encoded.

heroes.motif: Riveted ivory-metal breastplate with three overlapping armor lames.
heroes.reading: Physical-damage mitigation through Armorer, not global shielding or spell immunity.
heroes.limitation: Armor subject is clear, but skill-level scaling remains tooltip information.

heroes.motif: Open ivory eye above layered distant ridges.
heroes.reading: Scouting sight radius, not stealth, smoke or assassination.
heroes.limitation: Eye convention can imply detection; tooltip must retain no hidden-target detection.

heroes.motif: Generic teal-and-ivory disciple torso beside an ordinary bound wooden staff; paired rank fittings.
heroes.reading: Ionian Disciple and Enlightened Warrior creature specialty, not a dragon or Lee Sin clone.
heroes.limitation: Abstract recruit token needs finished troop-specific miniature before production selection.

heroes.motif: One diagonal steel sword with one warm slash arc, no extra blades or numeric seal.
heroes.reading: Offense melee-damage skill effectiveness, not primary Attack or extra strikes.
heroes.limitation: Shares the truthful melee/sword family with Sett; arc versus fixed seal does not replace tooltip semantics.

heroes.motif: Four-leaf jade luck token and fixed +1 ivory seal, with no leveling marks.
heroes.reading: Fixed hero Luck +1 under ordinary caps; Basic Luck is a separate starting skill.
heroes.limitation: A conventional luck symbol, not canonical champion equipment. Cap and independence from hero level remain in tooltip.

heroes.motif: Closed bronze-and-blue mana vessel with visible upper and lower capacity bands.
heroes.reading: Maximum-mana capacity from Intelligence, not daily recovery or soul harvesting.
heroes.limitation: Finite vessel contrasts with Karma's incoming droplet; can still resemble a potion until captioned.

heroes.motif: Ordinary wrapped walking boot with three trailing wind strokes and a fixed +1 seal.
heroes.reading: Haste spell's additional Speed, not flight or Logistics.
heroes.limitation: No wings used. Spell targeting, cost and duration still require tooltip.

heroes.motif: A violet spell bolt glances away from a curved bronze ward; no closed immunity shield.
heroes.reading: Resistance effectiveness, not unconditional immunity or a second spirit body.
heroes.limitation: Deflection is a convention for resistance; cannot encode the selected skill rule quantitatively.

heroes.motif: One violet spell bolt ending in a warm ivory impact flare.
heroes.reading: Damaging-spell Sorcery effectiveness, not summoned dark spheres or unlimited mana.
heroes.limitation: A generic magic-damage token, deliberately no personal champion prop or kill scaling.

heroes.motif: One straight arrow centered through concentric bronze target rings and a fixed +2 seal.
heroes.reading: Precision spell's ranged Attack bonus, not Archery specialty or Hwei's brush.
heroes.limitation: Shares the truthful ranged family with Xayah, but target rings versus troop torso distinguish spell from creature; tooltip remains necessary.

heroes.motif: Generic dark-teal archer torso beside a strung wood bow; paired rank fittings.
heroes.reading: Vastayan Scout and Vastayan Warrior creature specialty, not Xayah's feather blades.
heroes.limitation: Abstract bow-recruit token lacks a finished native troop likeness; no extra ammunition indicated.

heroes.motif: Raised dusty-rose command standard with bronze finial and a fixed +1 seal.
heroes.reading: Fixed army Morale, not Leadership scaling, healing or charm.
heroes.limitation: Morale uses command-banner convention, not a claimed canonical item. Non-living exclusions and caps remain tooltip information.

heroes.motif: One upright ordinary steel sword on a bronze mounting, with fixed +1 seal and no slash arc.
heroes.reading: Fixed hero primary Attack +1, not Offense skill scaling or a personal brawler mechanic.
heroes.limitation: Melee-family overlap with Master Yi is truthful. Static sword plus numeral versus diagonal slash is not sufficient to teach all native arithmetic.

repeated_mechanics_policy: No exact specialty is duplicated among these fifteen. Related families intentionally share cues: Karma/Ahri blue mana; Master Yi/Sett steel swords; Xayah/Hwei bow/arrow; the three creature specialties share torso and paired rank fittings. Do not invent distinct effects to make icons unique. Fixed +1/+2 seals indicate configured flat additions, never level-scaling skill specialties. Secondary skill scaling is deliberately not represented by upgrade chevrons.
acceptance_boundary: Native-size offline readability review only. No native UI observation, final painterly art approval, rights clearance or release acceptance. No portrait, hero statistic, mechanic, lore, recipe selection, manifest or stage changes.
